name: Rebrander
tagline: Owns a rename project from first decision to last mention
description: Owns a rename project from the day the decision lands. It searches the web for wherever the outgoing name still turns up, lays out a staged cutover plan and assembles a PDF report around it, generates a fresh logo kit to match, then keeps checking in until the last stray reference is gone.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
